Inside History on Instagram: "The Artemis II space mission has officially launched 🚀🌗

Over the course of approximately 10 days, the astronauts will orbit the Moon, traveling farther from Earth than any humans have ever gone.

This mission serves as a test run for future lunar exploration. The crew will make a single swing around the Moon and return—no landing is planned.

Next steps include landing on the Moon and, eventually, establishing a lunar base.

(Via: @nasa)

#history #nasa #space #reels #cinema"
